synopsis.native: Tomas, qui vit avec Martin, rencontre une jeune femme, Agathe, avec qui il entame une liaison. Un triangle amoureux s’ébauche sans que cela pose un problème à Tomas alors que les rapports avec Martin et Agathe deviennent de plus en plus difficiles. Tomas devra faire un choix...
synopsis.english: In contemporary Paris, German filmmaker Tomas (Franz Rogowski) embraces his sexuality through a torrid love affair with a young woman named Agathe (Adèle Exarchopoulos), an impulse that blurs the lines which define his relationship with his husband, Martin (Ben Whishaw). When Martin begins an extramarital affair of his own, he successfully gains back his husband’s attention while simultaneously unearthing Tomas’ jealousy. Grappling with contradicting emotions, Tomas must either embrace the confines of his marriage or come to terms with the relationship having run its course.
